sloka: अब्रवीच् च हनूमामः च सुग्रीवः च विभीषणम् ।कथम् सागरम् अक्षोभ्यम् तराम वरुण आलयम् ॥६-१९-२८॥।।
transliteration: abravīc ca hanūmāmaḥ ca sugrīvaḥ ca vibhīṣaṇam ।katham sāgaram akṣobhyam tarāma varuṇa ālayam ॥6-19-28॥।।

translations.english: "If one does not protect, or give refuge, according to his capacity out of fear, desire (to gain) or delusion, the sin acquired by him will be censured by the world."
